d: Mexico's booming avocado industry has become a target for drug cartels. In Michoacan, the country's biggest avocado-producing state, criminal groups are accused of extorting farmers, threatening businesses and controlling parts of the supply chain. Now, Mexican authorities have arrested Rafael Alvarez, alias R2, a suspected cartel operator accused of targeting avocado producers. But can this arrest break the cartels' grip on Mexico's billion-dollar avocado trade? Palki Sharma tells you.
